nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of every holder.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spending approvals.
Private uint256 holding the total minted token supply.
Private string holding the ERC20 token name, set once in the constructor.
Private string holding the ERC20 token symbol, set once in the constructor.
Private uint8 holding the token decimals, set once in the constructor.
Payable constructor of LumaParty: sets name/symbol/decimals, mints the full supply to tokenOwnerAddress and forwards msg.value to feeReceiver.
Public burn(uint256 value) that destroys value tokens from msg.sender's balance.
ERC20 transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) moving tokens from msg.sender.
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint256 value) granting an allowance from msg.sender.
ERC20 transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) moving tokens via the allowance of msg.sender.
Atomically increases the allowance granted by msg.sender to spender.
Atomically decreases the allowance granted by msg.sender to spender.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): validates addresses and moves balance entries.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount): increases _totalSupply and the account balance.
Internal _burn(address account, uint256 value): decreases _totalSupply and the account balance.
Internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 value): writes the allowance mapping.
Internal _burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount): burns from account and debits msg.sender's allowance.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled origin used as the owner/account for transfers, approvals and burns.
External Ether push feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value) executed inside the payable constructor, calling an address supplied at deployment.
State write to _balances performed by _transfer after SafeMath sub/add checks.
State write to _totalSupply performed by _mint and _burn.
State write to _allowances performed by _approve (direct assignment of the allowance value).

edges.reason: Constructor calls _mint to create the entire initial supply for tokenOwnerAddress.
Constructor performs an external Ether push to feeReceiver while still executing.
burn delegates to the internal _burn with msg.sender as the account.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
approve delegates to the internal _approve.
transferFrom delegates the balance move to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
_burnFrom calls _burn on the target account.
_burnFrom debits the caller allowance via _approve.
burn uses msg.sender as the account whose balance is destroyed.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of the moved tokens.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender whose allowance is debited.
increaseAllowance uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_burnFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is reduced.
burn value parameter is forwarded to _burn and controls how much of msg.sender's balance is removed.
feeReceiver constructor parameter determines the target of the external Ether transfer, which can execute arbitrary code.
tokenOwnerAddress receives the minted balance in _mint.
totalSupply constructor parameter is minted via _mint.
_transfer amount parameter drives the SafeMath sub/add updates written to _balances.
_burn value parameter drives the _totalSupply reduction.
approve spender parameter is written into the _allowances mapping.
approve value parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
transfer recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the destination account.
transfer amount parameter flows into _transfer as the moved quantity.
transferFrom sender parameter is the source account of _transfer.
transferFrom recipient parameter is the destination account of _transfer.
transferFrom amount parameter is the quantity moved and also debited from the allowance.
increaseAllowance addedValue is added to the current allowance inside _approve.
decreaseAllowance subtractedValue is subtracted from the current allowance inside _approve.
_transfer writes the debited and credited balances into _balances.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve writes the value into the _allowances state variable.

The external Ether push target can re-enter token entry points such as transfer during the payable constructor; the 2300 gas stipend of transfer() limits but does not eliminate the trust assumption on feeReceiver.
